name: 01-library
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a polished high fidelity desktop application UI concept for LoRA Studio, a Windows local LoRA model manager for ComfyUI. Linear-inspired visual design: extremely disciplined compact typography, near-black neutral charcoal #101114 canvas, #151619 sidebar, hairline #292a30 separators, light grey text, restrained lavender #8278ed accent, compact 6px rounded controls, precise alignment, understated professional productivity tool. Full straight-on 1600x1000 landscape screen, no perspective, no laptop, no external background, no marketing slogans, no large glows or gradients. Consistent left sidebar width 210px with brand LoRA Studio, search, main nav in Simplified Chinese: 模型库, 在线发现, 下载管理, divider, collections 人物角色, 画风风格, 场景建筑, and 设置 at bottom. Native compact titlebar with Windows controls. Main content generous usable space with dense professional controls and elegant hierarchy. Realistic tasteful model cover artworks, no explicit content. Chinese labels legible, English model names where useful. All data fictional concept examples.
Page specification: Model library page, 模型库 selected. Breadcrumb 工作空间 / 模型库. Heading 模型库 with small count 128, upper right 导入模型 purple button. Search field 搜索模型、标签或触发词, filter chips 全部, SDXL, Flux, SD 1.5, 类型, grid/list toggle. Four columns by two rows of beautiful moderately sized landscape cover cards: cinematic portrait of clothed adult woman, soft illustrated forest, architectural city, ceramic 3D object, anime adult character, watercolor hills, film street photo, ink mountains. Titles Cinematic Portrait, Forest Illustration, Modern Architecture, Soft 3D, Anime Character, Watercolor World, Analog Film, Ink Landscape. Compact card footers with base-model tag, file size, subtle favorite icon. Small sidebar collection counts. Subtle selected card thin violet outline. No oversized dashboard statistics.
